column1: # v3.39 — every comment in `pixcull/` that promises or postpones work,
# with what actually happened to it. Enforced by
# that is not in this file fails the suite, and so does an entry whose
# comment has been edited (the hash is of the comment text), because
# editing a deferral is the moment to re-state what it is waiting for.
# disposition ∈ done | wrong | undecided | open | not-a-promise
#   done          it shipped; the comment is kept for the history
#   wrong         the premise was false; superseded
#   undecided     a real fork nobody has chosen, with the tradeoff named
#   open          still waiting, and the reason is still good
#   not-a-promise the matcher hit an identifier, not a promise

column5: Said "display-only for now". Stopped being true when the meta judge shipped: build_packet reads every model_<axis>_stars into the packet as rubric_model. Comment rewritten in v3.39; the phrase survives only as a quote of what it used to say.
`todo` is the name of a filter key in the fallback ledger, not a marker. The comment is the v2.68.6 post-mortem.

Scoring reads the RAW, not the Lr-developed preview. Scoring the preview means judging the photographer's own correction back at them; scoring the RAW means a frame they already rescued can still come back flagged dark. Neither has been measured, so this is a fork nobody has chosen — not a queue item.
V22.2 shipped cross-run face-label inheritance in pixcull/pipeline/face_library.py, wired from _build_face_clusters_info via load_run_centroids + suggest_labels and written back by add_to_library.

V17.3 shipped per-vertical policy override: /verticals/tune/<key> writes policy_override.json through policy_tuner, and decide() reads it. It arrived as tune-from-samples rather than type-the-number, which is the same capability.
